title: Trước, sau, sau đó: sequencing a routine

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say how much, how many —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bao nhiêu] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say one —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: một] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say two —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hai] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say three —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ba] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say four —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bốn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say five —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: năm] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Em dậy trước. Sau đó em ăn sáng.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Chị nấu ăn trước hay sau?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, em nấu ăn trước.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Today's structure: putting your routine in order.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: First,] [VI: trước] [EN: means before. It has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: — high, rising. Listen again.] [VI_F: trước] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: trước] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: trước] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Next,] [VI: sau] [EN: means after. It has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: — flat, no mark. Listen again.] [VI_F: sau] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: sau] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sau] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Last,] [VI: sau đó] [EN: means then, or after that. You already know] [VI: đó] [EN: — this adds] [VI: sau] [EN: right in front of it. Listen to the whole phrase again.] [VI_F: sau đó] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: sau đó] [EN: Now you say it.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sau đó] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: You already know] [VI: rồi] [EN: — between two actions, it can also work like then. Listen.] [VI_F: Em dậy, rồi ăn sáng.] [EN: I wake up, then eat breakfast.]

[EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Before —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: trước] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: After —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sau] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Then, or after that —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sau đó] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill. Before —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: trước] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: After —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sau] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Then, or after that —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: sau đó] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now say it. I wake up before —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Em dậy trước.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: I eat breakfast after —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Em ăn sáng sau.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Then I go to work —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Sau đó em làm việc.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now reverse. I say the Vietnamese, you say the English.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: trước] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: before] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: sau] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: after] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: sau đó] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: then, or after that] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: One last time, before we move on.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: trước] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: sau] [PAUSE 1s] [VI_F: sau đó] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Remember,] [VI: trước] [EN: has] [EN: a high, rising tone] [EN: , and] [VI: sau] [EN: has] [EN: a flat tone, no mark] [EN: — flat.]

[EN: Listen again — now you understand it.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Em dậy trước. Sau đó em ăn sáng.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Chị nấu ăn trước hay sau?] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Dạ, em nấu ăn trước.] [PAUSE 1s] [EN: Your turn. One word to start —] [VI: ông] [EN: it means grandfather, or an older man. See you then.]
